summary: Permanent local correction history implemented per spec: every successfully saved correction that actually changes count or exercise type appends an immutable CorrectionEvent inside the same PersistedState transaction (schema 13→14 appended tail, older schemas migrate to empty). No event cap: count is only checked non-negative and entries are decoded incrementally so a corrupt huge count fails on EOF instead of preallocating. All checks pass: testDebugUnitTest (183 tests, 0 failures), assembleDebug, lintDebug.
findings: CorrectionEvent fields: id (unique event ID), receiptId (verification/receipt ID), correctedAtWallMs (epoch ms), originalType/originalValue (immutable reviewer measurement as wire string + count), correctedType/correctedValue (new wire string + count).
RESTRICTOR_SCHEMA_VERSION is now 14; history is written/read as an appended tail after lastExercise. Schemas <=13 decode to empty correctionHistory.

History is appended only when exercise != receipt.exercise || value != receipt.value; identical saves apply but add no entry, flag-only returns early with no entry, and editing back to an earlier value records a new event.

History lives in PersistedState, so it survives normalize() (both resets), clearReportHistory(), lastExercise replacement by new recordings, and restarts; no truncation or cleanup anywhere. App-data deletion/uninstall removes it (documented).
If dataStore.updateData throws, persistLocked returns false before persistedState is assigned, so neither history nor correction is published; a retry appends exactly one event (verified by test).

Pre-existing dirty work (schema 13 receipt feature, UI files) was preserved untouched; only declared write scopes were modified. RestrictorRepository.kt required no changes — atomicity rides the existing mutex/DataStore transaction.
Pre-existing compiler warning remains in ExerciseCorrectionTest.kt:33 (unnecessary !! smart-cast artifact from the earlier correction feature); left as-is to avoid churn on another agent's code.

DOCUMENTATION.md: added a Schema 14 paragraph documenting entry fields, no-op/flag rules, retention boundary (app-data deletion/uninstall only), and no sync/export/UI.
decisions: Stored history inside PersistedState rather than a separate log so the append is atomic with the correction under the existing repository mutex/DataStore path, per spec.
Recorded 'original' as the immutable reviewer measurement (receipt.originalValue/originalExercise.wireId) on every event, not the previous manual value, per spec wording.
Used String wire IDs (ExerciseId.wireId) for both type fields to stay extensible to future non-exercise validation types.

Rejected the 10_000 event cap after orchestrator correction: permanent history must never make corrections fail; corruption safety is preserved via non-negative count check + incremental decode + prompt EOF failure.
Kept StateSnapshot unchanged (no history field) since spec requires no history UI; tests observe persisted history through the DataStore's data flow.
